state-layer-guard.sh checks changed files against exclusions for active feature and blocks with exit 2 if violated

features.evidence: feature_list.json schema supports optional 'exclusions' list of string patterns. .claude/hooks/state-layer-guard.sh detects changed files and validates them against exclusions declared by active features (using exact and wildcard glob matching). Passed bash-compat-guard.sh.
